name: Sofya
tagline: Web search, page fetch, extraction and deep research for agents
description: Web tools for AI agents. Search the web and get full page content instead of snippets, fetch URLs as clean markdown (PDFs and Office documents included), extract specific information from a page with a prompt, and run multi-source research that returns a cited report. Hosted remote server; sign in with OAuth, or pass a Sofya API key as a Bearer token.

install.notes: Sign in with your Sofya account when prompted (OAuth). To use an API key instead, add --header "Authorization: Bearer <SOFYA_API_KEY>". New accounts get free monthly credits.
